_comment: Catalog-diff allowlist for the RLS regression harness. Every public table must be EITHER rowsecurity=true OR listed here with a reason. A new table that is neither fails the harness — that is the invariant that covers tables which do not exist yet. Entries whose table becomes sealed (or is dropped) are reported as stale warnings; remove them in the same commit that seals/drops the table.
